required_positive_properties.name: non-computable-under-budget target
required_positive_properties.requirement: Target is not exactly computable from <= budget legal channels.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Declared dependency set includes more or different information than budget permits, with a planned static derivation check.

required_positive_properties.name: oracle budget-faithfulness
required_positive_properties.requirement: Oracle is high because of legitimate partial-observation strategy, not answer-key, hidden-state, target-alias, future-label, or unqueried access.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Field-access manifest, legal query trace schema, budget ledger, and separate answer-key diagnostic oracle.

required_positive_properties.name: exhaustive legal-query resistance
required_positive_properties.requirement: Exhaustive legal query within budget leaves nontrivial remaining uncertainty.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Expected exhaustive_legal_query score below oracle minus band and explanation of what legal budget cannot reveal.

required_positive_properties.name: graph/cache heldout resistance
required_positive_properties.requirement: Graph/cache/table baselines are structurally disadvantaged on heldout generalization, not merely absent.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Heldout generation rule prevents table reuse of state/signature keys while preserving fair compute baselines.

required_positive_properties.name: fitted legal-channel learner resistance
required_positive_properties.requirement: Fitted legal-channel learner and strongest classical method are included and expected to remain below oracle.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Declared learner family, fit evidence fields, anti-stub guard, and expected heldout limitation.

required_positive_properties.name: passive value-level resistance
required_positive_properties.requirement: Passive family expected below ceiling by value-level analysis.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Value-level leakage scan plan, positive control, and passive family max threshold.

required_positive_properties.name: metric robustness
required_positive_properties.requirement: Balanced metric with per-class floor; degenerate and size-only controls must remain low.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Balanced macro-F1, per-class precision/recall floors, and degenerate baseline family.

required_positive_properties.name: split defeats memorization and simple compute
required_positive_properties.requirement: Train/test split defeats memorization and simple legal-channel compute on the same heldout split.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Split design states how context IDs, signatures, legal tuples, and target-generating rules avoid both lookup reuse and closed-form compute.

required_positive_properties.name: sufficient visible-oracle signal
required_positive_properties.requirement: Budget-faithful oracle has enough legitimate signal to exceed the oracle floor.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Expected oracle score floor and source of legitimate partial information.

required_positive_properties.name: strongest false explanation first
required_positive_properties.requirement: Sketch states strongest false explanation before any run and maps it to A1-A10.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: A1-A10 self-attack table, expected strongest cheap baseline, and explicit rejection condition.

required_positive_properties.name: complete independent battery
required_positive_properties.requirement: All required rows are present, consumed, and alias-collapsed before any promotion.
required_positive_properties.minimum_pre_run_evidence: Producer hashes, prediction hashes, input manifests, strategy signatures, baseline families, independence families, and consumed_by_final_verdict true.

required_positive_properties.name: oracle vs active-planner structural separation
required_positive_properties.requirement: The oracle advantage must be structurally distinct from fair budget-limited planning, or the sketch is treated as active-planner-equivalent and rejected or blocked.

positive_grammar_summary_r1: Design surfaces where the legal budget gives real but incomplete partial observation, the budget-faithful oracle has a concrete structural advantage over fair active budget-limited planners, and complete cheap fair baselines remain present and fail for stated, falsifiable structural reasons. Do not manufacture headroom by weakening, omitting, aliasing, underpowering, or restricting planner baselines.
claim_ceiling: Phase-0 environment design-constraint R1 repair only. No headroom confirmation. No Gate1 pass. No mechanism validity. No candidate feasibility. No runtime/mainline effect. No agency/autonomy/consciousness/EGO readiness.
